text: {"claims": [{"context": "general, cited from Bakkenist and Kastan 2003", "effect": "activates", "evidence_quote": "DSBs and other genome stress lead to a rapid conversion of the ATM pool into active S1981\u2013P monomers", "location": "Introduction", "source": "DSBs and other genome stress", "target": "ATM"}, {"context": "general, cited from Bakkenist and Kastan 2003; low level of DNA damage", "effect": "activates", "evidence_quote": "Phosphorylation of ATM on S1981, an early and essential step in the activation of this kinase, can be detected rapidly after IR, even when a low level of DNA damage is induced (Bakkenist and Kastan 2003).", "location": "Results", "source": "IR", "target": "ATM"}, {"context": "general, reviewed in Kastan and Lim 2000", "effect": "activates", "evidence_quote": "ATM phosphorylates and stabilizes p53 in response to DNA damage (reviewed in Kastan and Lim 2000).", "location": "Results", "source": "DNA damage", "target": "p53"}, {"context": "in IMR90 primary fibroblasts", "effect": "activates", "evidence_quote": "Quantitative immunoblotting showed that cells overexpressing TRF2 had a diminished ability to induce p53 after irradiation (Figures 2A and 2B).", "location": "Results", "source": "irradiation", "target": "p53"}, {"context": "in irradiated IMR90 control cells exposed to 20 Gy IR", "effect": "activates", "evidence_quote": "Extracts from irradiated control cells showed the previously reported retardation of Nbs1 and its reactivity with the S343\u2013P-specific Nbs1 antibody (Figure 2C).", "location": "Results", "source": "irradiation", "target": "NBS1"}]}
